summary_md: **Christian Nonis ([@christiannonis](https://x.com/christiannonis/status/2116175026009555181))** explains *MemDerive* ([arXiv 2610.25373](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25373)) from NUS/SJTU/0G Labs, which tests derived facts that follow from multiple records plus rules: Mem0, Cognee, LightMem and MemoryOS score 30–48% versus ~58% for BM25 and refresh only 41% of implicit changes; the proposed fix is versioned rules, dependency tracking and incremental view maintenance.

referenced_urls.title: MemDerive: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agent Memory over Evolving Data

relevance: Agent memory design informed by a hard benchmark.
